source_text: Following general procedure F using N‐(2‐(trifluoromethyl)benzyl)pivalamide (64.8 mg, 0.25 mmol), B2pin2 (95 mg, 0.375 mmol), [Ir(COD)OMe]2 (2.5 mg, 0.00375 mmol) and dtbpy (2.0 mg, 0.0075 mmol) in THF (1.25 mL). The reaction was stirred at 50 °C for 20 hours before cooling and the solvents removed. Analysis of crude 1 H NMR using internal standard 1,2‐dimethoxyethane showed 1:1.3 meta:para borylation in 100% yield. As the para isomer could be characterised from the reaction with 1a the product was not isolated.
